title: Quarterly Vision Track: Hosted API & Model Catalog Runway
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Define a compact, risk-aware quarterly runway for the Hosted API and Model Catalog that translates top-level OKRs into deliverable initiative threads. Scope covers: (1) model onboarding cadence and canary windows, (2) catalog tiering and deprecation rules, (3) capacity hedging policy for hosted endpoints, and (4) eval signal gating linked to rollback thresholds. Deliver a prioritized sprint plan, rollouts schedule, and a lightweight escalation playbook for capacity or quality regressions. This ticket is the PM-level synthesis that the SLT and Eng leads will use to sign off the Q2 commitment lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated initiative map that maps each OKR to 1–3 deliverables with owners and estimated points
Release calendar with canary windows, A/B gating, and rollback thresholds for the top 5 hosted models
Capacity hedge plan (reserved vs burst) with cost estimates and fallback policies validated by ENG
Model catalog tier definitions (Gold/Silver/Bronze) and automated tagging rules documented
Stakeholder sign-off (Product, Eng, Design, SRE) captured in the Confluence approval section

risks: Model quality regressions if canaries are shortened to meet capacity constraints
Underprovisioning during seasonal surges leading to increased latency and cost spikes
Cross-team dependency on kernel upgrades (runtime team) introduces release coupling
Manual catalog tagging could cause incorrect tier assignments and unexpected retirements
